name: roblox-studio
description: Build, script, and playtest Roblox experiences with Claude. Connects Claude to Roblox Studio's built-in MCP server and walks you through setup: installing and launching Studio with your approval, turning on the MCP server, and confirming the connection.

args: for candidate in "/Applications/RobloxStudio.app/Contents/MacOS/StudioMCP" "$HOME/Applications/RobloxStudio.app/Contents/MacOS/StudioMCP"; do [ -x "$candidate" ] && exec "$candidate"; done; echo "Roblox Studio MCP was not found. Install or update Roblox Studio, then reconnect." >&2; exit 1
